settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Anti-ghostwriting guardrails.
settings.identityDesc: Record your point of view, audience, voice and topics. Injected when generating skeletons so outlines sound like you — but AI still only gives outlines, never ghostwrites.
settings.idPovPh: e.g. Against mindless collecting; use output to force better input
settings.idAudiencePh: e.g. Knowledge workers escaping the collecting habit
settings.idVoicePh: e.g. Restrained, first person, few adjectives, lots of examples
settings.idTopicsPh: e.g. Knowledge management, writing, AI collaboration
settings.aiRatioDesc: Warn when AI words exceed this share of a piece.
settings.expandLimitDesc: How many times you can request an outline expansion.
settings.llmDesc: Bring your own key. Pick a provider, paste your API key, choose a model. Stored locally on this device only — never uploaded.
settings.llmKeyHint: Kept in this browser only; sent directly to the provider, never to our servers.
settings.llmTestEmpty: Connected, but the model returned empty content.
settings.llmIncomplete: Please fill in Base URL, API Key and Model first.
settings.llmProxyNote: Leave empty to use the deployment default (if configured).
settings.llmTestCors: This provider blocks direct browser calls (CORS) — no problem, requests will automatically go through the secure server proxy with your key.
settings.llmTestAuth: Auth failed: your API key looks invalid or lacks access.
